model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the number of issued permits for the construction of new buildings from 2012 to 2022. The x-axis represents the year, on a linear scale ranging from 2012 to 2022 with regularly spaced tick labels. The y-axis represents the number of permits, on a linear scale. The blue line represents Административни, with a solid line style and no markers, and starts at approximately 170 in 2012 and ends at 70 in 2022, declining steadily to 95 in 2020. The orange line represents Други, with a solid line style and no markers, and starts at approximately 4938 in 2012 and ends at 4631 in 2022; dropping to a low of 4323 in 2014 and rising to a high of 5980 in 2019. The grey line represents Жилищни, with a solid line style and no markers; and starts at approximately 4238 in 2012 and ends at 8169 in 2022, rising steadily from 5860 in 2020.
